name: map-idle
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: production low-resolution tactical-map SWORDMASTER animation sprite sheet. Image 1 is the EXACT POSE/PLACEMENT EDIT TARGET; replace each native NES sprite IN PLACE, do not change its pose, orientation, scale relationship, source slot order, feet, hand positions or sword angle. Image 2 is COSTUME/IDENTITY reference only. Render its stronger broad-shouldered swordmaster costume in a CHUNKY, SIMPLE tactical map pixel style, much simpler than the design sheet: pure dark navy hair, natural peach face with readable eyes, blue short tunic with contiguous ivory edging, broader ivory shoulder pieces, blue/navy boots, a short soft BLUE CLOTH CAPE falling on the original back/side. NO SHIELD. That wide native shape is CLOTH, never a shield or a rectangle with an emblem. Same man, same outfit and body size in every cell. Strict six colors: #172638 navy, #3976B5 blue, #E4E1C8 ivory, #DDA77D skin, #2C527E dark blue folds, #B5A16C tiny gold fasteners. No gradients, glossy hair/cloth highlights, dithering, grey wash, decorative speckle or extra colors. Keep each whole figure connected, swords and boots fully present, transparent background, generous separated margins, no text or labels. Keep head and torso stable across each pair, depict local limb/cloak changes only; no whole body bob or translation. Important: source arm shapes must be understood as arm/hand, sword held correctly, cape behind body; do not attach cape to sword. Exactly THREE poses in ONE horizontal row, left to right native idle0,1,2. All face three-quarter LEFT. Feet and torso are exactly the SAME stationary stance in all3. Only the sword-bearing right arm and sword change from slightly leaning outward at image left, to near-vertical, to vertical closer to face, as each source cell. The free left arm is at image right with cloth cape behind, NOT a shield. Skin, one eye, both boots visible. Do not invent walking/leg phases in this idle strip.
